entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I'm calling about an order... I need to return something. I'm just feeling really down about it and was hoping you could help.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?

Yes, it's VF-8820-9154. It's for the Aero Road Helmet. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and I really needed this money back for some unexpected bills. I was so worried I'd be stuck.

I understand, and I appreciate your loyalty. I have your order pulled up. To make sure I'm helping correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference?

Oh, there's nothing wrong with it. In fact, the box is still unopened. It's just... the online pictures made the color look different, and seeing it in person, I was a bit disappointed. I know safety is the most important thing, but I just can't justify keeping it if I don't love it, especially right now.
Thank you for clarifying that for me. I can see here that the helmet was delivered 75 days ago. Let me just check the return eligibility for this item. One moment please.
Okay... I'm really hoping you can help.
Alright, thank you for waiting. I've confirmed the policy. Since this is a standard item, it falls within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for you for a full refund.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a huge relief. I was so stressed about this. Thank you, Alex, that's wonderful news.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could get that sorted out for you. I've just emailed a prepaid return shipping label to the address on file. Just attach that to the package and drop it off at any post office.
I will do that this afternoon. Thank you again, you've really made my day.
My pleasure. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks so much.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
